app_units.scope: Full ExViewerTests target on iOS Simulator

recent_ui.scope: Split runs: nested detail/new search return, extension edit cancel/apply, library source in landscape, reader source return/page continuity, button/both-edge detail return, tag long-press management, fixed shell resize

phone.physical_user_acceptance: Installation and data continuity verified; new interaction acceptance remains separate

limits: Public unsigned Release build and original-team phone Debug build are separate artifacts
Controlled network and lifecycle tests are not real-site throughput or indefinite background execution proof
Scoped reader-details UI return does not establish that every hidden accessibility tree has no duplicate identifiers
iOS decides background execution duration and final system task notification wording
Launch snapshot cover preparation is bounded and keeps the older snapshot when not ready
